about.what.title: Fit tiles into a 10×10 board
about.what.body: Place the three pieces you are dealt. When a row or column fills up, gold runs through the cracks and the tiles are gone. The game ends when nothing fits. There is no timer.
about.modes.title: Four ways to play
about.modes.endless.body: Any time, as often as you like. Chase your own best.
about.modes.daily.body: Everyone plays the same board. Play it as many times as you like; your best of the day is the record.
about.modes.levels.body: Clear a target number of lines within a fixed number of trays. Only boards proven solvable are used.
about.modes.ranking.body: Today, this week, this month, all time. From the week onward it is the sum of your daily bests.
about.made.title: How it is built
about.made.body: No ads, no accounts, no third-party scripts. Open it once and it works offline. The daily board is grown from a seed made of the date, so everyone gets the same board and the same order of pieces. Scores are not taken on trust: the server replays your moves from the start to confirm them.
about.made.sound: The sound ships with no audio files — music and effects are synthesised as they play, at zero bytes.
about.kaizen.title: It changes a little every day
about.kaizen.body: This game measures how it is played, what breaks and how fast it loads. On days when those numbers say something, Claude writes one improvement, and only what passes the tests and budgets ships. If something breaks, it rolls back on its own.
about.kaizen.repo: Read the design docs and the change log (GitHub)
about.data.title: What gets sent
about.intro: HAMARU collects only what it needs to make the game better.
about.item1: We send an anonymous device ID, your results as numbers, error details, and load speed.
about.item2: The device ID is random. It is not linked to your name, email, or location, and "Delete all data" in Settings removes it.
about.item3: We never store IP addresses. Only the country is used, in aggregate.
about.item4: Browsers with Global Privacy Control enabled send nothing.
about.item5: Data is kept on Cloudflare for at most three months.
about.item6: If you join the leaderboard, we store an anonymized device ID, your nickname, and your daily challenge scores. You can leave in Settings, and “Delete all data” also removes your leaderboard records.
